articles.title: AI isn't replacing SREs, it's deskilling them
articles.summary: When AI handles 95% of incident response, do you get worse at handling the 5% that actually matters? Most SREs already use AI for daily work, and so do many knowledge workers. A 1983 research paper by Lisanne Bainbridge, which studied automation in factories, found that the more automated a process, the more critical the human operator becomes during rare failures and the less practice they get. This parallels the AI revolution, where workers who remain are left with the rare, complex problems, making them worse at handling exceptions.
